harnessNotes: Initial sandbox denied loopback listening with EPERM before imports/reports; the owned stalled process was identified and stopped. An authorized escalation then opened and closed a diagnostic listener and ran the isolated harness.
One disabled-control locator missed a form inside collapsed details; opened it and continued from inspected saved state. No duplicate action was retried.

No claim of actual-user V301, production identity acceptance or live deployment.
No provider reader, background scan, arbitrary agent execution or private session ingestion.
Pending request recovery is mounted-view only; leaving the view loses its envelope.

Previous verification artifacts remain historical to their exact source hashes.

followups.goal: Inspect a retained record from the owner-review checkpoint without leaving Session review, losing its draft/pending operation or advancing coverage.
followups.baselineObserved: Ordinary source-link activation wrote #session-…-event-intent; dashboard hash routing treated it as an unknown page and unmounted Session review. Database bytes stayed unchanged.
followups.rootCause: OwnerReviewReports used a plain fragment anchor, unlike existing in-review source navigation which prevents route changes.
followups.remediation: Pass the existing ReviewDetails event-navigation callback into OwnerReviewReports and prevent default routing on source-link activation. Preserve href target, pins, reports and all storage/permission semantics.

observations.outcome: Every retained item opens its exact focusable source section by keyboard or click without changing #day, unmounting Session review or creating a review checkpoint.
Unsaved non-contiguous report draft and item selections survive source inspection; stored bytes and no-checkpoint state remain unchanged.
After committed-response loss, source inspection preserves the exact pending operation and write lock; persisted reviewed 2/prefix 1 and bytes are unchanged.
Exact replay uses identical body/request ID, retaining one report checkpoint and two operations/audit entries including manifest creation; partial count and gap remain.
Unknown-attribution item source remains inspectable while retained-selection denominator, contiguous gap and original-transcript unknown limits stay explicit.
Correction to unresolved retreats coverage to reviewed 1/prefix 0; source inspection preserves corrected state and both immutable checkpoints.
Source navigation remains in-view at 320/375px and after reload; corrected prefix, history and database bytes survive unchanged.
Exact target retains heading-derived accessibility name; no durable browser storage, original-source read or transcript-completeness claim introduced.

followups.persistence: Existing companion migration applied explicitly only to each newly created disposable owner-bound TEST DATA database. UI created manifest, appended items 1 and 3, reconciled the same committed-but-unseen body and corrected item 1 to unresolved. Replay retained one report checkpoint and two companion operations/audit entries including manifest creation. Correction preserved two immutable checkpoints. Navigation/reload retained exact database bytes at each checked stage.
followups.coverage: Five retained records, three excluded dispositions and one unknown-attribution record from the existing selected fixture.
